source_snapshot.procedure: Authenticate and GET `/redfish/v1/Systems/system`, then grep PowerState; source embeds credentials in the URL, disables TLS verification and says to clear logs before test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Redfish response is readable, correct and error-free.
source_snapshot.script: Private power-state-oob; 5 attended and 5 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; compares Redfish PowerState with IPMI power status but uses `-k`, command-line secrets and grep rather than secure structured parsing.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE at LOW risk using secure structured Redfish GET and read-only IPMI state on the verified same target, normalized comparison, complete evidence and no power/log mutation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Adds a useful independent IPMI cross-check but does not secure authentication/TLS or define a structured state mapping.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly keeps full automation while enforcing same-target proof, schema parsing and a strict read-only boundary.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Redfish and IPMI may express states with different vocabularies and timing. The comparator must pin the allowed mapping and a bounded observation timestamp so a legitimate transition does not become a false mismatch and a stale response does not become false agreement.

original_test_intent: Verify the current power state of one identified system is readable through Redfish and correct when reconciled with an independent IPMI power-status observation, without changing power or logs.
original_method: Prove the Redfish system resource and IPMI endpoint identify the same SUT, use protected sessions and trusted TLS, parse complete Redfish JSON and IPMI output, normalize states with the approved mapping at correlated timestamps, compare results, and retain redacted evidence without any control action.
manual_activity: No interactive action is required for an ordinary supported read; the package owner pre-validates resource discovery, TLS trust and the Redfish-to-IPMI state map and reviews only unsupported or inconsistent results.
required_inputs: Approved TLS trust or documented exception
safety_requirements: Never issue On, Off, Cycle or Reset
Do not place credentials in URLs or evidence
Do not use unapproved TLS bypass
Parse complete responses rather than grep fragments
Fail closed on ambiguous or mismatched states
agent_execution_scope: Read and parse IPMI power status
Archive complete redacted evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Review asynchronous or persistent state disagreement

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The two read operations fit the intent, but `-k`, command-line password exposure and grep-based parsing do not meet the secure structured evidence contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a protected Redfish session to GET the canonical system resource with certificate validation and parse JSON `PowerState`; then run protected read-only IPMI power status and compare normalized timestamped values.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB PowerState scope and 5/5-minute estimate remain; generic log clearing and insecure credential/TLS patterns are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store complete Redfish/IPMI responses, resource and chassis identity, acquisition timestamps, normalized states and mapping version in one comparison record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces credential-in-URL, TLS bypass and grep with protected sessions, structured parsing and an independent state oracle.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A readable field alone cannot prove correct target, current state, valid schema or agreement with the chassis power controller.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power transitions can create brief cross-interface lag; only the approved bounded stabilization policy may distinguish transient from persistent disagreement.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define canonical system resource discovery, certificate trust and the allowed Redfish/IPMI state mapping including transition states. This row never authorizes a power change to manufacture a desired result.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/resource identity, firmware and same-target proof
Complete Redfish JSON and parsed PowerState with timestamp
Complete IPMI power-status output with timestamp
Normalization mapping, agreement or bounded mismatch result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target a read-only Redfish power-state observation. The IPMI cross-check strengthens correctness; insecure command syntax and generic clearing are method defects, not competing objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The canonical resource, protected clients and state mapping are normal package inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if secure authentication/TLS, same-target proof or unambiguous state parsing cannot be established.

review_improvement: Transforms a fragile grep of an insecure URL into a secure, timestamped and independently reconciled power-state measurement.
independent_technical_reasoning: PowerState correctness has identity, semantic and temporal dimensions. Redfish must refer to the intended ComputerSystem, IPMI must address the same chassis, their enumerations must be normalized, and samples must be close enough to compare. Satisfying only transport success leaves all four failure modes undetected.
